articles.title: The Rock's Surprising New Gig: Singing a Tender Ballad for His Daughters
articles.summary: Dwayne Johnson, famous for action movies and wrestling, just released a sweet song called 'Your Dad' for his three daughters. He co-wrote it with American Idol winner Iam Tongi. The video shows home movies of him with his girls!

articles.title: Kris Bowers to Score Netflix's 'Steps,' a Cinderella Twist
articles.summary: Composer Kris Bowers will score Netflix's animated movie 'Steps,' a twist on Cinderella's stepsisters. It hits Netflix on November 20. The score was recorded at Abbey Road Studios!

articles.title: The Forgotten Aretha Franklin Album That Quietly Changed Music
articles.summary: In 1976, Aretha Franklin recorded a soundtrack for a little-known film called Sparkle. It flopped on the pop charts but became a cult classic. One track, "Something He Can Feel," hit No. 1 on the R&B chart. Why does this album deserve a second listen?
